Class GameOverlayController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.ui.overlay.GameOverlayController
public class GameOverlayController extends Object
Coordinates the display and interaction of game overlays (Pause and Game Over).

This controller acts as a facade for managing the different overlay states in the game. It delegates specific rendering and logic to PauseOverlayController and GameOverOverlayController, ensuring a clean separation of concerns.

Responsibilities include:

  • Initializing and managing overlay sub-controllers.
  • Routing callbacks (e.g., resume, restart, quit) to the appropriate handlers.
  • Controlling the visibility of pause and game-over screens.
